messages:
oncall-bot: Pager PAGER-5721 fired — elevated 95th percentile latency on /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Affected customers: batch inference jobs and realtime endpoints. Severity: P2. Auto-scaling did not kick; three workers pending. Link: https://redwood/ops/incidents/PAGER-5721 :rotating_light:

Maya: seeing the bot — I'm currently primary for EU night but ran into a family emergency. I need to drop at 00:40 UTC, can someone take the remaining ~2h? I've started a mitigation attempt but not committed. :frowning:

Maya: quick summary of what I did: checked the autoscaler (aws-aurora-scaler) — it shows 3 pending pods. Tried to trigger a manual scale but `kubectl scale` returns `quota exceeded` in the eu namespace. Logs attached in the infra channel.

Lee: on it. I'm parked nearby and can pickup. Are you able to hand over current context? any running bridges?

Maya: no bridge yet. I opened the RT bridge via `redwood incident start --id PAGER-5721` but didn't join — that's on me. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/latency-eu. Key notes: check `inference-worker` pods, look for OOM or restart loops, and check hot-shard KV cache hit rate. If autoscaler blocked by quota, we can temporarily switch routing to lower-cap model variant: `model: gpt-open-60k -> gpt-open-16k-quant` to reduce memory.

AJ: I can join the bridge and shadow for the handoff. @Lee please take primary if you can. I'll stay on-call for escalation.

Lee: confirming takeover. Maya — can you paste the exact `kubectl get pods -n eu` output? saves time. Also any customer-impact messages?

Maya: pasted logs: ```
$ kubectl get pods -n eu
NAME                                    READY   STATUS    RESTARTS
inference-worker-0                      0/1     Pending   0
inference-worker-1                      1/1     Running   2
autoscaler-eu                           1/1     Running   0
```
Plus a chunk of failing node events: `FailedScheduling: 0/10 nodes are available: Insufficient memory.`

Pablo: quick question — is this a quota at the cloud project level or k8s resource limits? If it's cloud quota, we need infra to request burst from cloud provider; if it's k8s, maybe we can evict some low-priority batch pods.

Maya: looks like cloud quota (account-level), requests are being throttled. I started an infra ticket (INFRA-802) — ETA unknown.

Lee: OK plan: 1) I'll join the bridge and set routing fallback to the lower-memory model for realtime routes (minimize customer impact), 2) AJ keep pager escalation path open in case we need to escalate to Dedicated pool, 3) Pablo, can you prepare an eviction plan for non-critical batch jobs if infra ETA slips past 15m?

AJ: joining bridge now — https://redwood/bridge/PAGER-5721. Oncall phone at hand. If we swap primary, we should annotate alert and update rotation doc.

oncall-bot: User Maya marked handoff requested at 00:38 UTC. Primary assigned: Lee. Secondary: AJ. Handoff note: pending infra quota request INFRA-802.

Lee: took primary. Performing safe fallback: run `redwood routes update --service inference --fallback-model gpt-open-16k-quant --route-prefix /v1/generate` (doing it now).

Lee: done. Observability dashboards show 95th latency dropping from 3.2s to 1.1s for the realtime test route. Bulk jobs still queued.

Pablo: eviction plan ready. I'll evict non-critical batch pods in 10m if infra doesn't respond. I'll annotate with `evicted-by=oncall` + link to this thread.

AJ: thanks — keeping pager open. Maya, hope you're ok. If infra approves quota, we can scale back up and revert fallback. Action items: oncall handoff recorded, bridge active, fallback applied, infra ticket INFRA-802 pending, eviction ready.

Maya: thanks all. I'm going to step out now — Lee, AJ you have everything. Appreciate the cover. :heart:

Lee: no worries. We'll keep this thread updated. If anyone sees errors after model fallback, ping bridge and mention `@rigid-ops` for immediate attention.

sre-bot: Incident PAGER-5721 updated: status=mitigated (latency reduced); assigned_to=Lee; notes="fallback routing applied, infra quota requested, batch eviction on standby". Closed alerts: 4/4.

Lee: closing the immediate customer-facing loop — sent update to #support with short blurb and ETA for revert. Will monitor for 30m and then hand back to rotation if infra resolves.

AJ: I'll stay secondary until 01:10 UTC then hand back to rotation.

Maya: back now and available for followups starting 02:10 UTC. Thanks team.
